incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGE: Dedicated cluster zenith-dedicated is reporting elevated 5xx rates and connection resets for tenant ZenithHealth. Alerting on gateway 502/504 spike and TCP RSTs. Initial detection 2188880000.

alicia (oncall): on it, jumping in. tagging ben and carla. what scope are we seeing?

ben (eng-sre): seeing ~18% 502/504 across the zenith-dedicated ingress for the last 3m. tail latency up, backend workers hitting connection reset errors. sample log: `gateway -> backend: 502 upstream read error: connection reset by peer`.

carla (runtime): I can repro locally against a small repro client — the worker processes serving long-seq batches are saturating TCP backlog and then resetting. looks like one tenant is sending very large parallel requests.

alicia (oncall): customer impact? devon?

devon (cust-succ): ZenithHealth reports intermittent failures in inference for ~30% of requests to their critical /generate endpoint. They're seeing timeouts in-prod and some of their dashboards are throwing 5xx alerts. They're being paged by their on-call.

ben (eng-sre): digging into per-tenant metrics: ZenithHealth accounted for ~65% of tokens in the past 10m and concurrent streams peaked ~6x above baseline. KV cache miss rate also spiked which increases compute. This looks like capacity exhaustion from a single tenant (noisy neighbor-style).

carla (runtime): confirming noisy-neighbor pattern: worker goroutines starved due to huge attention windows + long sequences. memory pressure caused soft OOMs and connection drop. stack trace snippet: ```runtime: out of memory? alloc failed at kv_cache_put -> evict loop slowed```

emily (infra): options: 1) throttle ZenithHealth concurrency (fast), 2) scale up dedicated pool (slower), 3) temporary routing to fallback smaller model or hosted pool (safer). Recommend quick throttle + background scale.

alicia (oncall): agree. ben, can you push tenant concurrency cap? carla, prepare fallback model route. emily, spin up extra nodes as a pre-warm.

ben (eng-sre): running command: `infractl tenant update --tenant ZenithHealth --concurrency-limit 12 --reason "emergency throttle due to burst"`

ops-bot: Command accepted. Applying change to zenith-dedicated.

ben (eng-sre): change applied 2188880065. Monitoring...

carla (runtime): deploying routing rule: `routingctl create --cluster zenith-dedicated --match tenant:ZenithHealth --fallback-model rdm-small-quant --pct 30` to shift 30% of requests to smaller model variant to reduce load.

ops-bot: Routing rule created. ID r-9a3f.

alicia (oncall): initial metrics after throttle+routing: 5xx rate dropped from 18% -> 5% within 30s. connection resets falling. latency tail improving.

devon (cust-succ): I told ZenithHealth we're applying protection and routing some traffic to a smaller variant — they'll accept temporarily if it stabilizes their service.

ben (eng-sre): still seeing occasional spikes tied to large batch jobs from ZenithHealth, but well within capacity now. autoscaler shows scale activity queued. emily, what's ETA on scale-up?

emily (infra): new reserved nodes booting, expected available 3m. pre-warming KV caches.

carla (runtime): added a protective circuit-breaker for large seqs in the routing layer: `if seq_len>8192 -> route to rdm-small-quant` applied. Should reduce future blasts.

alicia (oncall): good. I'll keep monitoring and stay on this thread until we hit stable state for 15m. ben, please collect the spike trace and top 10 offending request patterns. carla/emily, follow up with config and capacity changes in postmortem. devon, coordinate with the customer for post-incident notes.

ben (eng-sre): grabbing traces and sample requests now. saving logs to /incidents/2188880000/trace-zip.

alicia (oncall): 15m check-in: 5xx steady at 2-4%, no new connection resets. marking incident as mitigated but not resolved. starting handoff to next on-call.

emily (infra): scaled +2 nodes completed 2188880150. KV cache warm.

alicia (oncall): handoff -> emily (next oncall). action items: 1) postmortem (due 24h) 2) tenant rate-limit policy proposal (dev) 3) autoscale tuning for long-seq workloads (carla/emily).

emily (infra): got it, will take over monitoring.

devon (cust-succ): ZenithHealth appreciates the quick response. They asked for a follow-up call tomorrow to discuss quotas and billing impact.

alicia (oncall): thanks team. closing active page. creating incident record in incidents board and assigning postmortem to carla.

incident-bot: Incident documented: INC-2188880000. Postmortem owner: carla.

alicia (oncall): :white_check_mark:
